name: Vegetation fire detections from satellite (NASA FIRMS)
plain: How many times a satellite saw a grass or brush fire burning in the area during the year.
definition: The number of VIIRS active fire detections on NOAA-20 in the area in the calendar year that FIRMS tags as presumed vegetation fires with nominal or high confidence.

coverage.frequency: Yearly; a finished year's file appears in the first months of the next (refresh unit fires).

method: fires.py downloads FIRMS's yearly country files for Puerto Rico for NOAA-20 (VIIRS 375 m, standard processing; 2019-2025) and keeps the detections FIRMS tags as presumed vegetation fires (type 0) with nominal or high confidence. A detection belongs to the municipio of the barrio that holds its pixel's center, or the nearest within about 500 m; farther ones (at sea) are left out. For the last 12 months the build, in GitHub Actions with FPR's MAP_KEY, reads the FIRMS area API for the Puerto Rico box in 5-day windows (standard processing where it reaches, near real time after); near-real-time detections carry no type, so those within 400 m of a place the yearly files mark as a static land source are left out. Checks at every build: each complete year 50 to 2,000 detections, and more than half in the dry south and southwest (68% in this build).
source_detail: NASA FIRMS (https://firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/), VIIRS 375 m active fire detections on NOAA-20: yearly country files 2019-2025 and the area API for 2025-11-10 to 2026-11-09. Credit: NASA FIRMS. Municipio land area: Census (crosswalk).
how_to_read: Puerto Rico had 103 detections in 2025, the fewest since 2019; the most were in 2019 (408). Over 2019-2025 (1,393 in all), most were in Salinas (273), Ponce (111) and Juana Díaz (106). About 64% of all detections fall in January to April, the dry season.
caveats: A detection is a hot 375 m pixel, not a fire: one fire seen on two passes counts twice, a large fire fills several pixels, and a small fire or one under clouds is not seen.
NOAA-20 passes about 1:30 in the afternoon and 1:30 at night; fires that start and end between passes are missed.
Only detections FIRMS tags as presumed vegetation fires count; industry and power plants (static sources) are left out.
Counts of a small municipio change a lot from year to year: read several years together.

name: Vegetation fire detections per 100 km² of land (NASA FIRMS)

definition: Fire detections in the year divided by the area's land area (Census, km²), times 100.

name: Vegetation fire detections, last 12 months (NASA FIRMS)
plain: How many times a satellite saw a grass or brush fire burning in the area in the last 12 months.
definition: The number of VIIRS active fire detections on NOAA-20 in the area from 2025-11-10 to 2026-11-09, from FIRMS's area service (standard processing where it reaches, near real time after), with nominal or high confidence and not near a static land source.

coverage.frequency: The 12 months to the day before the build; rebuilt monthly in GitHub Actions (refresh unit fires).

method: fires.py downloads FIRMS's yearly country files for Puerto Rico for NOAA-20 (VIIRS 375 m, standard processing; 2019-2025) and keeps the detections FIRMS tags as presumed vegetation fires (type 0) with nominal or high confidence.
